verdict.rationale: RudderStack's compliance toolkit claims to block, mask, or encrypt PII before it reaches downstream tools. Its Transformations feature filters and reshapes event data before delivery to destinations, so the core PII-control capability is first-party. However, the evidence is marketing-level and never shows hashing or explicit per-destination scoping. Missing for 10: explicit hashing support, documented per-destination PII rules, field-level filtering docs specific to sensitive attributes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes

citations.quote: Block, mask, or encrypt PII before it gets downstream, so every team can move fast with confidence.
Transformations let you filter, enrich, and reshape event data before it reaches your destinations.
Endless flexibility to transform your event data in flight with JavaScript or Python
